inner.title: keep a processing record
inner.body: it lists what personal data you process, why, who gets it and how long. the under 250 staff exemption barely exists.
inner.label: do the paperwork

inner.title: your vendors' leaks count
inner.body: a dpa makes vendors act only on your instructions. in 2025 the cnil fined one €1 million for keeping 46 million users' data.
inner.label: €1m fine

inner.title: collect less
inner.body: the cnil says collect only data that is adequate, relevant and necessary. data you never collected is data you can never leak.
inner.label: less is safe

inner.title: the 72 hour clock
inner.body: the edpb says notify your regulator within 72 hours of becoming aware. every breach must be documented anyway, even unreported ones.
inner.label: start the timer

inner.title: answer within one month
inner.body: a user asking for their data gets a free copy within one month. in 2025 the cnil made 14 decisions against firms failing requests.
inner.label: 14 decisions
